english.note: Use this mainly for a scornful expression, tone, or attitude, especially in more careful or formal language.
Use this mainly in written or formal descriptions of a contemptuous attitude, look, or manner.
Use this more formal adjective for an explicitly disdainful attitude, expression, or look.
